data.body: ADR numbering note (2026-09-07): 0118 in this story is a PLACEHOLDER. Task arterial-bilineate-vampirebat (a01e-01e7-6e6e-4809) also targets ADR 0117, and `scripts/check_adr_numbers.py` enforces a bijection, so take the next free number at landing (`ls docs/adr/.numbers | sort | tail -1`, plus one) and substitute it in the file name, the `.numbers` marker, `docs/adr/README.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, and the release notes. The docs epic's consolidated reconciler record (placeholder 0119) lands after this and shifts by the same offset.
